title: Manager, People Operations – APAC
description:
**Description**


Manager, People Operations – APAC  

  

We’re looking for a dynamic People Operations Manager for our APAC region (Japan, China, Hong Kong, Australia, Singapore, Malaysia, India) to drive operational excellence and lead our People Ops team across the APAC region. This is a people manager role that combines strategic thinking with hands\-on execution. You’ll be responsible for delivering exceptional employee experiences, leading regional HR initiatives, managing day\-to\-day People Operations tasks, ensuring operational excellence and leading a high\-performing APAC People Operations team.
  

  

As a trusted leader, you’ll work closely with cross\-functional stakeholders, regional managers, and global HR colleagues to bring consistent, high\-quality People Operations support throughout the employee lifecycle and focussing on operational excellence. This role will be reporting directly to the Senior Director, People Operations.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead and manage the APAC People Operations team, providing coaching, guidance, and career development.
* Oversee the execution of core HR processes across the region — onboarding, offboarding, HRIS transactions, employee job changes, benefits, and immigration.
* Ensure compliance with local labor laws and internal policies across APAC locations.
* Partner with the global People team on company\-wide projects, bringing an APAC lens to HR initiatives.
* Partner with Sr. Director, People Operations to drive operational efficiency, process improvements and automation initiatives across the employee lifecycle, including Workday workflows, JIRA ticketing systems and onboarding platforms.
* Build strong relationships with employees and managers, delivering proactive support and timely resolution of People\-related queries.
* Lead vendor relationships for benefits, background checks, and contractor onboarding in APAC.
* Serve as a regional subject matter expert and advisor to business leaders on People Ops best practices, programs and provide scalable solutions.
* Lead training initiatives and enablement programs for employees and managers in maintaining operational efficiency and self\-serve initiatives.
* Lead global and APAC internal audits and also manage people systems audit ensuring data integrity and compliance.
* Own or co\-lead strategic People Operations projects that enhance employee experience and operational excellence in the region.
* Generate and analyze HR metrics and reports to inform decision\-making, support the rest of the People Team with reporting and data insights.

**Qualifications \& Skills**:

* 6 \- 8\+ years of progressive HR/People Operations experience, with at least 2 years in a managerial or team lead capacity.
* Proven track record of delivering People Ops services in a high\-growth environment.
* Strong knowledge of HR practices and compliance requirements across multiple APAC countries.
* Prior experience using Workday (preferred) or other HRIS platforms.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Google Suites, showcasing prowess in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* High attention to detail and strong project management, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with a high degree of empathy and discretion.
* Ability to do presentations and deliver programs.
* Ability to collaborate across time zones and work effectively in a global, matrixed organization.
* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources or a related field preferred.

 **What You Bring:**

* A passion for building scalable processes and improving employee experiences.
* The ability to lead through change and ambiguity.
* A hands\-on, team\-first mindset with a balance of strategic thinking and tactical execution.
* High emotional intelligence and an authentic leadership style that inspires trust and results.

  

What We Offer:

* Enjoy flexible paid time off options for enhanced work\-life balance.
* Comprehensive health insurance tailored for you.
* Employee assistance programs cover mental health, legal, financial, wellness, and behaviour areas to ensure your overall well\-being.
* Complimentary CalmApp subscription for you and your loved ones, because mental wellness matters.
* Energetic work environment with a hybrid work style, providing the balance you need.
* Benefit from our family leave program, which grows with your tenure at Meltwater.
* Thrive within our inclusive community and seize ongoing professional development opportunities to elevate your career.

  

Where You'll Work:  

Hyderabad

  

When You'll Join:  

October/November 2026


Our Story


At Meltwater, we believe that when you have the right people in the right environment, great things happen.


Our best\-in\-class technology empowers our 27,000 customers around


the world to make better business decisions through data. But we can’t do that without our global team of developers, innovators, problem\-solvers, and high\-performers who embrace challenges and find new solutions for our customers.


Our award\-winning global culture drives everything we do and creates


an environment where our employees can make an impact, learn every day, feel a sense of belonging, and celebrate each other’s successes along


the way.  

  

We are innovators at the core who see the potential in people, ideas and technologies. Together, we challenge ourselves to go big, be bold, and build best\-in\-class solutions for our customers.


We’re proud of our diverse team of 2,200\+ employees in 50 locations across


25 countries around the world. No matter where you are, you’ll work with people who care about your success and get the support you need to unlock new heights in your career.


We are Meltwater. Inspired by innovation, powered by people.


Equal Employment Opportunity Statement


Meltwater is an Equal Opportunity Employer and Prohibits Discrimination and Harassment of Any Kind: At Meltwater, we are dedicated to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace where every employee feels valued, respected, and empowered. We are committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity and strive to provide a work environment that is free from discrimination and harassment.  

  

All employment decisions at Meltwater are made based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion or belief, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, marital status, veteran status, or any other status protected by the applicable laws and regulations.  

  

Meltwater does not tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, and we actively promote a culture of respect, fairness, and inclusivity. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities to apply and join us in our mission to drive innovation and make a positive impact in the world.  

  

We may use AI to assist in aspects of our hiring process, such as reviewing candidate information, capturing interview notes, and supporting interview activities. These tools are used only to assist our team through increased efficiencies. Every output continues to be reviewed by humans, and all hiring decisions are made by humans. We remain committed to evaluating candidates fairly, consistently, and in compliance with all applicable laws

title: Manager, Channel Operations – Contracts & Pricing Execution (AIN)
description:
India \- Hyderabad
JOB ID: R\-255176 LOCATION: India \- Hyderabad WORK LOCATION TYPE: On Site DATE POSTED: Sep. 17, 2026 CATEGORY: Information Systems
**Manager, Channel Operations – Contracts \& Pricing Execution (AIN)**

**Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients**


At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.


Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.


Our award\-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

**What you will do**


As the Manager, Channel Operations – Contracts \& Pricing Execution (AIN), you will lead AIN\-based execution of U.S. Channel operations within the Contracts \& Pricing Execution function. This role is responsible for managing Channel Payments, Channel Analytics, contract update processing, CDP maintenance, GCPS administration, scorecard validation, payment package governance, product launch support, operational controls, reconciliations, reporting, documentation, and continuous improvement activities.


Reporting to the Senior Manager/Director, Contracts \& Pricing Execution, you will partner closely with ATO Channel SMEs, National Account Managers, Pricing, Market Access, Trade Operations, Finance, Information Systems, Commercial Operations, and AIN cross\-functional teams to ensure accurate, compliant, scalable, and audit\-ready Channel execution. The role will lead AIN Associates and Analysts to support Channel operations while preserving appropriate ATO oversight for strategic decisions, complex contract interpretation, customer\-facing engagement, approvals, and risk management.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Channel Operations Leadership*

* Lead end\-to\-end execution of Channel operations including contract update processing, CDP management, GCPS administration, scorecard generation, payment processing, waiver governance, analytics support, reconciliations, and payment package readiness.
* Manage workloads, operational calendars, payment cycles, quarter\-close deliverables, issue inventories, exception management, and execution readiness across Channel processes.
* Ensure repeatable and scalable execution of standard\-state activities transitioning to AIN while maintaining proper escalation pathways for complex decisions and approval requirements.
* Establish operational discipline through KPI management, workload balancing, service expectations, quality reviews, readiness gates, and issue escalation frameworks.

*CDP, Contract \& GCPS Governance*

* Oversee Monthly and Quarterly CDP Update processes, Conga review activities, contract amendment assessments, and operational implementation of approved contract changes.
* Lead GCPS setup, maintenance, strategy updates, tracker governance, and program configuration activities.
* Ensure CDP\-to\-GCPS alignment, execution quality, peer\-review effectiveness, and appropriate documentation retention.
* Partner with NAMs and retained ATO stakeholders on contract interpretation, amendment impact assessments, and complex operational decisions.

*Payments, Validation \& Financial Controls*

* Oversee scorecard generation, DOH validation, net sales reconciliation, payment package readiness, waiver processing, and payment calculation activities.
* Lead review of performance reports, scorecards, payment packages, trend reporting, and reconciliation outputs.
* Ensure SOX\-aligned controls, documentation standards, review evidence, decision logs, and audit readiness requirements are consistently maintained.
* Drive operational governance across payment approvals, exception resolution, reconciliation reviews, and control execution.

*Analytics, Reporting \& Operational Insights*

* Lead Channel analytics support including net sales reconciliations, inventory reporting, compliance reporting, DOH analysis, 852/867 validation activities, and operational dashboards.
* Review variances, trends, recurring exceptions, payment drivers, and operational metrics to improve execution quality and transparency.
* Ensure reporting outputs support decision\-making, payment approvals, audit requirements, and operational planning activities.
* Drive reporting standardization, KPI adoption, and analytics maturity across the Channel organization.

*Product Launch \& Continuous Improvement*

* Oversee AIN execution support for product launch readiness, MMDS activities, approved WAC maintenance activities, master data coordination, and launch documentation governance.
* Partner with ATO launch SMEs on transition planning, launch support activities, SOX documentation requirements, and process readiness.
* Drive automation, simplification, AI\-enabled opportunities, reporting improvements, issue reduction initiatives, and workflow optimization.
* Support system enhancements, UAT execution, defect management, access readiness, and digital transformation initiatives across Channel operations.

*People Leadership \& Transition Readiness*

* Lead, coach, and develop AIN\-based Medicaid Associates / Senior Associates supporting Medicaid operations and transition execution.
* Build a structured onboarding and KT model across learning, shadowing, reverse shadowing, supervised execution, and readiness sign\-off before independent ownership expands.
* Partner with ATO Medicaid SMEs to define skills, proficiency levels, QA standards, escalation rules, and readiness criteria for each Medicaid process step.
* Create a culture of accountability, compliance, quality, continuous improvement, stakeholder service, and One CPE collaboration across ATO and AIN.

*Compliance, Controls \& Audit Readiness*

* Ensure compliance with SOX controls, internal policies, pricing governance requirements, audit standards, and applicable pharmaceutical contracting regulations
* Maintain audit\-ready documentation, approval evidence, decision logs, dispute records, and process workpapers supporting operational compliance.
* Identify operational, compliance, financial, and data integrity risks and lead mitigation and remediation efforts.
* Support internal, external, and SOX audit activities and drive closure of audit observations.

**What We Expect of You**


We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The ideal candidate is a strong Medicaid / managed markets operations leader with experience in U.S. healthcare or pharmaceutical rebate operations, financial controls, systems enablement, and people leadership. This individual combines operational discipline, Medicaid domain knowledge, analytical rigor, stakeholder collaboration, and a continuous improvement mindset to build a scalable AIN Medicaid capability.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, Business Administration, Economics, Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Engineering, Analytics, or related discipline.
* 8 to 13 years of progressive experience in pharmaceutical, biotech, Gross\-to\-Net, Channel operations, revenue management, contract operations, commercial finance, analytics, or related areas.
* 3\+ years of experience leading people, operational teams, or complex cross\-functional delivery.
* Experience partnering with U.S.\-based stakeholders across Finance, Market Access, Pricing, Contracting, Commercial Operations, Compliance, IT, or Revenue Management organizations.
* Experience leading process execution, reporting, controls, documentation, reconciliations, or operational transformation initiative

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Deep understanding of Channel Payments, distributor agreements, fees and rebates, inventory management rebates, DOH methodologies, scorecards, net sales reconciliations, payment package governance, and Gross\-to\-Net operations.
* Experience with Model N GCPS, SAP, Conga, IntegriChain, Tableau, Qlik, Power BI, Power Query, Alteryx, SharePoint, and automation technologies.
* Experience supporting SOX controls, operational audits, access governance, issue management, UAT activities, and system enhancements.
* Demonstrated success leading transitions, KT programs, process standardization, automation, reporting modernization, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Strong stakeholder management, executive\-ready communication, people leadership, analytical, and change\-management skills.

title: Banking Operations Manager
description:
**Company Description**  

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.  

**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**


Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.


As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.  

**For everyone, everywhere.**


More about **our mission** and **what we offer**.

 **Job Description**  

Banking Operations Management is a global function with regional specialisation across APAC, Europe, NorthAm, MEA and LatAm. The team currently has 7 Banking Operations Managers, supported by the BOM Function Lead and project management support.


The team is currently based across Singapore, São Paulo, Austin, Budapest and Tallinn. APAC currently has two BOMs in Singapore; this role will add a third APAC BOM in Hyderabad to support the scale and complexity of the region. Current BOM scope excludes Japan.


The role reports to the Banking Operations Managers Function Lead. It is a senior individual contributor role with high autonomy, broad stakeholder exposure and a strong expectation to build structure where it does not yet exist.

 **Here’s how you’ll contribute:**

* Own operational relationships with key global banking partners, including regular performance reviews, escalations and action follow\-up.
* Drive partner performance by monitoring speed, reliability, incidents, service level agreement (SLA) gaps, risk signals, fees and avoidable operational costs.
* Translate complex internal problems into partner improvement plans, making sure issues have owners, next steps, timelines, escalation paths and expected outcomes.
* Hold partner banks accountable for operational commitments, including SLA performance, incident resolution, responsiveness and long\-term fixes.
* Support incident and post\-incident corrective action follow\-through for issues caused by or involving partner banks, making sure root causes are understood and repeated problems are addressed.
* Build operational visibility across Wise by improving shared partner records, documentation and reporting around partner performance and relationship management.
* Work with Banking, Finance, Legal, risk and controls, and banking governance teams on partner fees, losses, contract/SLA discussions, controls and regulatory expectations.
* Help regional and internal teams work more effectively with banking partners by sharing context, best practices and clear operating routines.

  

**Qualifications**  

* You are placed in **Hyderabad**, and have a **right to work in India**
* You have **5\+ years of experience** in **banking operations, payment operations, partner/vendor management, risk management, operational excellence** or a similar field.
* You understand **payment operations** and **banking partner relationships.**
* You are **highly data\-driven**: you can investigate issues, form a clear hypothesis, size the impact and build an evidence\-based case for action.
* You are strong at **stakeholder management** and can **influence** internal teams and external partners **without direct authority**.
* You are comfortable having **difficult conversations** and holding partners or internal teams accountable in a clear, constructive way.
* You can **operate in ambiguity**, prioritise across a broad portfolio and move work forward without waiting for perfect instructions.
* You communicate **clearly and concisely**, especially when translating complex operational issues for different audiences.
* You have a strong **ownership mindset**, good judgement under pressure and a practical approach to solving problems.
* You care about **controls, documentation and operational resilience**, especially where partner performance can affect customers, risk or customer money.

**Nice\-to\-haves:**

* Experience working directly with banks, payment schemes, correspondent banking or high\-volume payment infrastructure.
* Experience running operational reviews, quarterly business reviews or service reviews with banks, vendors or strategic B2B partners.
* Experience with SLA management, contract discussions, liability, fee reconciliation or cost recovery.
* Experience in Treasury Operations, liquidity, safeguarding, financial risk or operational risk.
* Experience with SQL, Looker, Tableau or other data tools.
* Experience working across global teams, time zones and senior stakeholder groups.
* Additional language skills relevant to global banking partner management.

  

**Additional Information**  

For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.


We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.  

Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.


If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.


Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

title: Director – CRM Transformation and Operations
description:
### **Summary**

The Director – CRM Transformation and Operations will provide strategic and operational leadership for the Salesforce\-based CRM ecosystem supporting US commercial teams. This role will lead a multi\-disciplinary organization of approximately 65 associates across CRM Product and Operations , CRM Data Integrations, CRM Labs, Field CRM Operations, and Marketing Automation. The role is accountable for shaping the CRM transformation agenda, supporting platform adoption, enabling scalable product and data capabilities, strengthening operational excellence, and ensuring that salesforce capabilities deliver measurable business value for field, marketing, and commercial stakeholders.
### **About the Role**

**Director \- CRM Transformation and Operations**

**Location – Hyderabad \#LI Hybrid**

**Major Accountabilities:**

* Lead and develop a 65\-member CRM Transformation and Operations organization across CRM Product and Operations, CRM Data Integrations, CRM Labs, Field CRM Operations, and Marketing Automation.
* Drive CRM transformation initiatives that improve user adoption, data quality, field productivity, marketing effectiveness, workflow automation, and overall customer engagement excellence.
* Establish strong governance for CRM intake, prioritization, release planning, operational readiness, change management, and value realization in partnership with business and technology stakeholders.
* Provide leadership oversight for CRM data integrations, ensuring reliable, compliant, and business\-ready data flows across CRM and connected platforms.
* Guide CRM Labs and innovation teams to pilot, scale, and industrialize new CRM capabilities, including automation, advanced analytics, AI\-enabled workflows, and productivity enhancements.
* Ensure Field CRM Operations delivers high\-quality, timely, and compliant operational support to sales and field teams across geographies and business units.
* Partner with Marketing, Commercial Operations, Data, Technology, and US business stakeholders to enable integrated campaign execution, marketing automation, segmentation, targeting, and omnichannel engagement capabilities.
* Define, monitor, and report KPIs related to platform adoption, operational quality, delivery performance, data integrity, stakeholder satisfaction, and business value realization. Build a high\-performing, outcome\-oriented team culture focused on collaboration, accountability, innovation, coaching, and continuous improvement.

**Essential Requirements:**

* Essential Requirements: Experience in pharmaceutical, healthcare, life sciences, or regulated commercial environments, with strong understanding of field force effectiveness, CRM\-enabled customer engagement, and operational governance.
* Proven track record of leading Salesforce CRM transformation, platform enablement, and operational excellence programs that improve adoption, data quality, process efficiency, and measurable business outcomes.
* Strong strategic thinking, analytical judgment, and enterprise problem\-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex CRM, data, and operational challenges into clear priorities, delivery roadmaps, and actionable business outcomes.

**Desirable Requirement:**


Novartis seeks a senior leader with deep experience in CRM transformation, commercial operations, and large\-scale platform enablement within the pharmaceutical, healthcare, life sciences, or similarly complex regulated industries. The candidate should be able to lead large cross\-functional teams, influence senior stakeholders, modernize CRM operating models, and create a collaborative, accountable, and innovation\-driven work environment.

**Minimum Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in technology, Information Systems, Marketing, Life Sciences, or a related field; master’s degree preferred.
* 15\+ years of overall professional experience, including significant leadership experience in CRM, commercial operations, platform enablement, digital transformation, or technology\-enabled business operations.
* Strong Salesforce CRM experience, including product roadmap management, business process transformation, adoption, release governance, and operational support.
* Proven ability to lead large teams, preferably 50\+ associates, across multiple functional areas and delivery portfolios.
* Strong understanding of CRM data, integrations, marketing automation, field operations, omnichannel engagement, and commercial technology ecosystems.
* Excellent executive communication, stakeholder influencing, problem\-solving, and change leadership skills.
* Ability to operate in a fast\-paced, matrixed, global environment while ensuring quality, compliance, and business impact.

title: USI-EH27-Consulting Services-FT-FinOps-Manager/Executive Manager – Treasury Operations
description:
**Finance Transformation – Treasury operate**  

Join our Finance Transformation practice to help Deloitte client service teams define and execute Treasury strategies and operations agendas. You will be part of a high\-performing team dedicated to delivering value in dynamic client environments, leveraging technology, navigating regulatory changes, and driving process improvements to enable transformative treasury management. **Position Summary** **Manager/Executive Manager – Treasury Operations**  

The Manager/Executive Manager plays a pivotal role in ensuring accurate, efficient, and compliant treasury operations for our clients. This role requires close collaboration across teams to guide all major treasury activities—cash management, Foreign Exchange, Accounting, reporting, process documentation, and technology enablement—while fostering strong client relationships and leading operational excellence. **Work You Will Do*** Demonstrate deep understanding of treasury practices, cash management, payment workflows, reporting, and technology to drive accurate and efficient operations.
* Oversee daily, monthly, and yearly treasury activities: cash management activities, payment initiation, bank account administration, signatory management, reconciliations, and compliance with policy standards.
* Lead preparation of covenant compliance reports, board and management presentations, and key performance metrics to support executive decision\-making.
* Provide subject matter expertise in cash management, FX, treasury accounting, regulatory compliance, hedging strategies, investment, and intercompany activities across global operations.
* Document and implement Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for treasury, driving process consistency and best practices.
* Serve as primary contact for clients in managing banking relationships, onboarding/offboarding accounts, and resolving treasury queries.
* Mentor and supervise team members while maintaining constant communication with clients to manage performance, foster professional development, enable effective client engagement, and ensure smooth delivery of services.
* Identify and implement automation and process improvement initiatives in cash management, payments, FX, and reporting using technology\-enabled solutions.
* Drive transition initiatives, oversee training programs, and manage change processes by leveraging Treasury Management System (TMS) tools such as SAP, Kyriba, and Visio to facilitate process redesign and migration.
* Experience being part of transformation (implementing TMS, optimizations) is highly desirable and would significantly enhance team capabilities.
* Conduct research on complex treasury issues and develop actionable recommendations for clients and teams.
 **Qualifications*** 9\+ years of post\-qualification experience in treasury operations, including leadership roles in corporate or consulting environments.
* Certified Treasury Professional (CTP) preferred.
* Strong working knowledge of Treasury Management Systems (Kyriba, SAP, Quantum, etc.) and banking portals.
* Experience in team leadership, client relationship management, SOP development, Operational excellence, Treasury transformation, and process improvement.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills, strong analytical ability, and attention to detail.
**Education**  

MBA, Master’s in Finance, or Bachelor’s in Accounting/Business. **Location** Hyderabad **Shift/Work Timings*** Flexibility required to work various shift timings, including night shifts as needed by business.

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Relay Operations Center (ROC) is the central command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon Supply Chain network supporting multiple geographies like NA, and EU. It ensures hassle free, timely pick\-up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon facilities and to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, ROC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on the proceedings.  

  

In addition to this tactical problem solving, ROC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data.  

  

Overall, ROC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:  

* Managing a shift, constantly identifying opportunities to improve team performance and owning associated change management. This is Work from Office position
* Developing and/or referring to performance metrics to drive team performance and business results.
* Identifying the business impact of trends and making data backed decisions. Able to learn and become a SME of the process (where engaged)
* Communicating with external customers (Carriers, Vendors/Suppliers) and internal customers (Retail, Finance, Software Support, Fulfillment Centers)
* Escalating problems or variances in the information and data to the relevant owners and following through on resolutions.
* Ability to pull data from numerous databases (using Excel, Access, SQL and/or other data management systems) and to perform ad hoc reporting and analysis, as needed, is a plus.
* Serves as escalation point for transportation specialists.
* Owning process/business level reports/actions and diving compliance..

title: Branch Operations Manager
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Position:** Branch Operations Manager  
**Location:** Hyderabad, Telangana  
**Department:** Business Operations  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time  
**Reporting To:** Founder / Managing Director  
**Experience:** 5–8 years  
**Preferred Background:** Consulting, strategy, branding, business advisory, professional services, B2B services, or a high\-accountability business environment

**ABOUT MAGSmen**

Magsmen is a business\-integrated brand consulting firm working at the intersection of business strategy, brand strategy, market intelligence, communication, experience, digital systems, governance, and commercial growth. Magsmen does not approach branding as a communication exercise. The objective is to understand the business, diagnose structural problems, create strategic clarity, and translate that clarity into measurable business outcomes.

Our approach moves through Discovery, Diagnosis, Design, Delivery, and Development. Our work addresses business positioning, market intelligence, audience behaviour, brand perception, identity, communication, digital infrastructure, financial alignment, legal and governance considerations, internal culture, and future readiness.

The Hyderabad branch is intended to become a serious regional business centre for Magsmen. The Branch Operations Manager will be responsible for building the operating discipline, commercial performance, client relationships, team capability, and regional presence required to achieve this.

**ROLE PURPOSE**

The Branch Operations Manager will own the day\-to\-day business operations of the Hyderabad region and will be accountable for branch revenue, business development coordination, client management, project execution, team productivity, collections, process discipline, market development, and operational performance.

This is not an administrative coordination role. The person will act as the operating bridge between Magsmen’s central strategic direction and Hyderabad execution.

The manager must be able to look at Hyderabad as a business unit and continuously answer five questions: Where is revenue coming from? What is blocking conversion? What is happening with every active client? Where is the team losing productivity? What needs to change now?

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Branch Business Ownership**

Own Hyderabad branch performance against agreed revenue, profitability, client, team, and operational targets. Convert company\-level objectives into a regional operating plan covering client acquisition, revenue, pipeline, delivery, manpower, partnerships, and market development. Establish weekly, monthly, and quarterly operating rhythms. Track performance against targets and identify deviations early. Maintain visibility on revenue, collections, sales pipeline, proposals, active projects, receivables, team productivity, client health, and operational risks. Solve problems within the branch wherever authority permits and escalate only matters requiring leadership intervention.

**Revenue and Commercial Operations**

Own the commercial operating discipline of the branch in coordination with business development and consulting teams. Maintain a structured pipeline from prospecting through qualification, meetings, proposals, negotiation, closure, onboarding, and collection. Ensure every opportunity has an owner, value, stage, probability, next action, and expected closure date. Track lead\-to\-meeting, meeting\-to\-proposal, proposal\-to\-closure, and closure\-to\-collection conversion. Diagnose lost opportunities and identify issues relating to pricing, positioning, proposal quality, competition, decision\-maker access, or sales execution. Support senior leadership in high\-value meetings and negotiations. Ensure commercial commitments match approved scope, pricing, and delivery capacity. Prevent uncontrolled discounting and commercially weak commitments. Track receivables and payment milestones closely.

**Business Development and Hyderabad Market Development**

Build Magsmen’s presence within Hyderabad’s business ecosystem. Develop relationships with founders, promoters, CXOs, investors, family businesses, professional networks, institutions, industry associations, and relevant ecosystem stakeholders. Identify sectors and business clusters where Magsmen can create significant strategic value. Develop a regional opportunity map covering target companies, decision\-makers, business stage, strategic problems, opportunity value, and relationship status. Build structured prospecting and referral systems rather than depending entirely on inbound leads. Represent Magsmen at relevant business forums, founder communities, conferences, and industry events. Focus on high\-quality strategic opportunities rather than lead volume.

**Client Management**

Own the quality of the client experience from onboarding to project completion and subsequent engagement. Establish clear communication between clients and internal consulting, strategy, research, creative, digital, and specialist teams. Monitor expectations against contracted scope. Identify scope creep, delays, communication gaps, quality concerns, and relationship risks before they become escalations. Track client health, satisfaction, repeat business, referrals, pending decisions, commercial opportunities, and risks. Support account expansion when genuine strategic requirements emerge while maintaining commercial discipline. Protect Magsmen’s reputation in every client interaction.

**Project and Delivery Operations**

Create operating discipline across Hyderabad projects. Ensure every project has defined objectives, scope, deliverables, timelines, responsibilities, dependencies, review points, and completion criteria. Monitor progress against agreed timelines. Coordinate internal resources and resolve bottlenecks involving information, approvals, people, assets, or decisions. Maintain project documentation. Track resource utilisation and project economics where applicable. Ensure final outputs meet Magsmen’s consulting standards and agreed client mandate. Distinguish between strategic problems and execution problems and intervene accordingly.

**Team Management**

Manage and develop the Hyderabad team. Establish responsibilities, reporting structures, priorities, and performance expectations. Conduct regular team and individual reviews. Monitor productivity and capability gaps. Ensure employees understand both what they are expected to execute and the business reason behind the work. Build accountability around ownership and deadlines. Address underperformance early. Work with leadership on recruitment, onboarding, training, performance management, and retention. Develop future team leaders. Ensure the branch reflects Magsmen’s standards of strategic thinking, commercial discipline, client confidentiality, professional conduct, and intellectual honesty.

**Process and Operating System**

Build and continuously improve the Hyderabad operating system. Standardise recurring processes covering sales coordination, client onboarding, project initiation, project tracking, reporting, collections, reviews, documentation, and feedback. Identify processes that can be simplified or automated. Ensure CRM and internal systems remain accurate and current. Build dashboards and reporting systems that give leadership a clear view of branch performance. Introduce SOPs where recurring operational failures are identified. The objective is not bureaucracy. It is predictability.

**Performance Reporting**

Prepare regular branch performance reports for senior leadership covering revenue, collections, pipeline, conversion, projects, profitability, client health, team productivity, recruitment needs, risks, and regional opportunities. Reporting must include diagnosis, not merely numbers. Where targets are missed, identify the cause, owner, corrective action, and timeline. Where performance improves, determine whether the improvement is sustainable.

**Financial and Commercial Discipline**

Coordinate with finance to monitor branch\-level billing, collections, receivables, expenses, project costs, and profitability. Ensure commercial commitments are properly documented and approved. Monitor project scope against contracts and flag margin erosion, excessive resource usage, delayed billing, unapproved work, and payment risks. Develop strong commercial judgement. A project can be successful for the client and still be commercially weak for Magsmen.

**Governance, Legal and IP Discipline**

Ensure branch operations comply with Magsmen’s policies, client agreements, confidentiality requirements, intellectual property standards, and applicable legal and regulatory requirements. Protect client information, strategic documents, proprietary frameworks, research, commercial information, and other confidential assets. Ensure employees do not make unauthorised commitments. Maintain discipline around Magsmen’s proprietary methodologies, templates, presentations, research, frameworks, and intellectual property. Escalate potential contractual, legal, reputational, confidentiality, IP, or compliance risks immediately. Support appropriate documentation of contracts, statements of work, approvals, commercial commitments, and client communications.

**Brand Representation**

Represent Magsmen professionally in the Hyderabad market. Ensure branch communication remains consistent with Magsmen’s positioning as a strategic consulting firm and is not reduced to conventional advertising, design, or marketing agency work. Maintain consistency across meetings, proposals, presentations, events, office interactions, digital communication, and client servicing.

**Market Intelligence**

Continuously track Hyderabad’s business environment and identify opportunities relevant to Magsmen. Monitor emerging industries, investment activity, GCC development, startup growth, family business transitions, corporate restructuring, D2C growth, technology adoption, category disruption, and changing founder priorities. Identify recurring strategic problems and convert relevant intelligence into business development opportunities. Feed regional intelligence back to leadership.

**Leadership Support**

Support the Founder and senior consulting leadership on major Hyderabad initiatives. Prepare client intelligence, meeting briefs, opportunity assessments, business information, and follow\-up plans. Translate leadership decisions into execution and follow initiatives through to completion. Identify issues that leadership may not see because of distance from daily operations. The manager is expected to solve problems independently rather than become a messenger between leadership and employees.

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS**

Performance will be measured through outcomes, not activity volume. Core KPIs include Hyderabad revenue against target, collections against billing, qualified sales pipeline, proposal\-to\-closure conversion, new client acquisition, average account value, repeat business, referral generation, client retention, project delivery against timelines, project profitability, client satisfaction, team productivity, employee retention, receivables ageing, operating cost discipline, and branch contribution to overall Magsmen growth.

Additional measures will include reduction in operational errors, speed of issue resolution, reporting quality, process maturity, and reduced dependence on Founder intervention.

**CANDIDATE PROFILE**

The ideal candidate will have 5–8 years of experience in business operations, consulting operations, professional services, business development, account management, or a comparable B2B environment. Demonstrated experience managing teams, targets, clients, and measurable business outcomes is essential.

Strong commercial understanding and financial awareness are required. The candidate should be comfortable with CRM systems, project management systems, dashboards, reporting, and structured operating processes. Experience in consulting, branding, advertising, business advisory, or professional services is preferred. Hyderabad market knowledge and an established professional network will be an advantage.

The person must demonstrate strong communication, negotiation, analytical thinking, problem solving, project management, people leadership, client management, and execution discipline. The candidate must be comfortable handling ambiguity, deadlines, commercial pressure, difficult conversations, and multiple priorities.

**WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT**

This is not an office administration position, pure sales position, client servicing coordinator role, or project coordination role. It is a business operations leadership position where revenue, delivery, people, client experience, finance, and market development must operate as one system.

**FIRST 90 DAYS**

During the first 30 days, the manager will understand Magsmen’s methodology, business model, active clients, sales pipeline, team structure, delivery system, financial processes, reporting mechanisms, internal standards, and Hyderabad market.

By 60 days, the manager should have established branch operating rhythms, pipeline visibility, project tracking, team reviews, client health tracking, reporting, and immediate corrective actions for operational gaps.

By 90 days, the manager should be independently operating Hyderabad against measurable accountability for revenue, pipeline, delivery, people, collections, and client experience, with a clear regional growth plan.

**SUCCESS DEFINITION**

The Branch Operations Manager will succeed when Hyderabad operates as a predictable and commercially accountable business unit rather than a collection of individuals.

The objective is to build a branch capable of acquiring the right clients, delivering high\-quality strategic work, collecting revenue on time, retaining strong people, protecting Magsmen’s intellectual property and reputation, and creating a sustainable regional growth engine.

**COMPENSATION**

Compensation will be based on experience, capability, and demonstrated commercial ownership. A performance\-linked component may be attached to agreed branch\-level business outcomes.

**APPLICATION**

Candidates should submit their CV along with a brief note describing their experience in managing business operations, revenue, teams, clients, and measurable business outcomes. Shortlisted candidates may be required to complete a practical case exercise based on a simulated Hyderabad branch operating problem.

Magsmen is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are based on capability, experience, performance, professional conduct, and organisational requirements.

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
